name: Duplex-GS
definition: A dual-hierarchy framework for real-time order-independent Gaussian splatting that combines alpha-blending with reformulated Weighted-Sum Rendering (WSR) to eliminate popping and transparency artifacts while reducing sorting overhead.
summary: Duplex-GS is a dual-hierarchy rendering framework that eliminates popping and transparency artifacts in Gaussian Splatting by using cell-level sorting and physically grounded transmittance for real-time order-independent rendering.
